Nights and recordings of clips used to train a classifier

Source: R/training.R
training_nights.Rd

Reads the site, date and time of the source recording from the names of training clips (of the current classifier, or of the reference library folders of another one) and returns their recordings and nights. Pass the result to exclude_from_test of build_training_set(), so that a test set does not hold nights another compared classifier was trained on, or to exclude_training_clips().

Usage

training_nights(
  files,
  pattern = paste0("(?<site>[A-Za-z]+)[A-Za-z0-9]*",
    "_(?<date>\\d{8})_(?<time>\\d{6})"),
  site_map = NULL,
  night_cutoff = 12
)

Arguments

files

File names or paths of training clips. Elements that are folders are listed recursively.

pattern

Perl regular expression with the named groups site, date (YYYYMMDD) and time (HHMMSS). The default takes the letters before the recorder number, the date and the time of names such as ARA01_20211016_190000 or ..._ARA_ARA01_20230121_203000_12.0s_15.0s.wav.

site_map

Optional named character vector to fix diverging site names, e.g. c(BEP2 = "BEP"), as in read_validations().

night_cutoff

Recordings that start before this hour belong to the night of the day before, as in detection_history().

Value

A tibble with file, site, recording (site, date and time of the source recording, before site_map) and night (YYYYMMDD). Names that do not match pattern are left out with a warning.

See also

build_training_set(), exclude_training_clips().

Examples

training_nights(c("ARA01_20211016_190000_3.0s_6.0s.wav",
                  "ARA01_20211017_013000_9.0s_12.0s.wav",
                  "FNJV_0042_Boana_raniceps.wav"))
#> Warning: 1 file name(s) do not match `pattern` and were left out: FNJV_0042_Boana_raniceps.wav
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   file                                 site  recording           night   
#>   <chr>                                <chr> <chr>               <chr>   
#> 1 ARA01_20211016_190000_3.0s_6.0s.wav  ARA   ARA_20211016_190000 20211016
#> 2 ARA01_20211017_013000_9.0s_12.0s.wav ARA   ARA_20211017_013000 20211016
